findings.evidence: Lines 773–775 explicitly state that exposure is for carrier reduction; `orthogonalQuotient_toFiniteBilinearModule` already publicly records the required identification at lines 823–825, while `orthogonalQuotientProdAddEquiv` relies on the leaked defeq at `Orthogonal/Prod.lean:286–291`.
findings.fix: Remove `@[expose]` and construct the quadratic product equivalence through an explicit transport/equivalence lemma, using the existing `orthogonalQuotient_toFiniteBilinearModule` characterization rather than unfolding the subgroup body.
findings.issue: `@[expose]` makes the implementation of `subgroupInOrthogonalComplement` part of the public reduction API merely so `Orthogonal/Prod.lean` can reuse the bilinear quotient by definitional equality.

summary: The new quadratic product implementation leaks an internal subgroup body solely to obtain definitional equality across modules.
